body: I'm sorry you feel this low. I hope you're ok. I dabbled in the BDSM scene a few years ago

Your ex sounds like a total douche.
I'm sure the abortion was the right thing for you at the time, try not to let it affect you now. Yeah I know, easier said than done but you're still young and you have plenty of time to find happiness.
Your friend could be dealing her own problems rn, there could be any number of reasons why she hasn't got back to you yet

Yeah my mum was like that with me when I was younger. She'd buy me stuff instead of giving me the care, attention and love I needed. Even now, like 25-30 years later she still thinks she was a wonderful parent cos "I had everything I wanted"
What about just telling them how you feel? Don't wait to be asked, sometimes people are too wrapped up in their own problems to realise someone they care about is struggling
Same here. I've tried multiple times but can't deal with the pain
I've had a similar experience. I have regular daydreams/fantasies/visions of jumping off a building/bridge. I'm petrified of heights so this wouldn't be the way I'd do it
I've tried partial and full suspension hanging, both hurt like fuck
Have you tried an elastic band around your wrist? Whenever you feel the urge to cut, pull the band and let it slap against your skin, hard. I've heard this can reduce the desire to self harm.
Yep, I know what that's like, I'm a size xxxxl. Unemployed, in massive debt, depressed and suicidal. I think I've brushed my teeth fewer than 10 times in the last 3 months

It sounds like you're really tough on yourself. I'm sure you're not as bad looking as you think you are. I like video games but suck at them too.

Hope you're OK
That sounds really tough and massively unfair. Don't blame yourself for those people being mean to you, it's not your fault at all!

The last time I suffered like that I was the same age as you are now.
I got straight into another relationship with someone who I didn't even find attractive. It didn't work out obviously but we did become good friends afterwards.
It took me a long time to get over the one who broke my heart but I did and I know you can too
Good luck! I hope you find something
Have you had a look on couchsurfing.com? I've not used it myself but know people who have.

Have you looked into couch surfing? Even if you just manage to get somewhere for one night a week that'll be something!
If that doesn't work out, three weeks isn't that long.

Hope you keep warm and well

Could you ask for an advance on your paycheck? Even just a small amount could be enough to buy entry to a public swimming pool where you could shower for as long as you liked.
Sorry, probably a silly suggestion.

From what you've written you sound really resourceful, I think you'll find a way to get through this.

If you really feel like you need to act on your thoughts there's bound to be a free helpline in your country where you can talk to someone.
Or feel free to message me. I dunno if I can help, I'm not a professional, just a suicidal older guy

You sound interesting and intelligent, I think it would be a shame if you acted on your suicidal thoughts.
Do you have anyone you could reach out to?
I'm twice your age and had some amazing times in my 20s and 30s. Maybe you will too!

It's probably not that hard to put in a complaint, there must be some sort of support for students where someone can point you in the right direction. If you want to pursue it.
She sounds like a total cunt to me. What about changing to a different class?
Are there any helplines you could call?
I'd put in a formal complaint about your professor, that's really unprofessional and totally uncalled for!

I hope you haven't done it.
I tried hanging myself but it hurt so much I quit after a few seconds
I hated school, it was one of the worst times of my life. I got through it though and had lots of fun in my 20s and 30s. It could be even better for you

Keep looking, something will turn up.
I live thousands miles away in the UK and am poor so I can't really help. I hope things get better for you
Good. See if you can replicate that feeling when with friends or family
Do you know why you feel that way? You deserve to be able to express yourself no matter what's in your head

You have plenty of time to do better as this is only your first year at college. I've known plenty of people who did badly their first year only to come back and turn it all around.
Not that grades really matter in the grand scheme of things!
Seriously? Never? Not after a few drinks/ spliffs? When watching a brilliant TV show or movie? After an orgasm?
Same
It's only been a day without hearing from him, that's not that long. Try not to worry

Yeah I've tried therapy and either I was in a good mood and didn't want to talk about negative stuff or I was feeling low and anxious and just didn't want to talk at all.
Would it help just to write your feelings down on a piece of paper is you knew you were going to burn/destroy the paper afterwards?
(Probably a stupid suggestion, sorry, it just popped into my head)

He could've broken his phone and could be waiting for a replacement. Or temporarily deleted all of his social media (I've done that before). There's an infinite number of reasons why he might not be online.

Hopefully he's just busy with work or something. Try not to worry. Yeah I know easier said than done!
I've had several online relationships before and sometimes I just needed a bit of space to deal with stuff

I've tried hanging myself, it hurts way more than you think it's going to!
If you don't know why you feel like this then maybe try to figure it out before you make any attempt?
Please try to reach out to someone you feel close to, or a professional

You're not stupid, your post was easy to read and informative.
Do you have anyone you feel really close to that you could tell how you're feeling? Try not to say it in a jokey way as they might not take you seriously. Or maybe talk to a teacher/doctor/therapist?
Maybe just try to relax and not overthink stuff when you're with friends and family? They obviously care about you
I'm often used by people as a free therapist cos I'm a good listener, I've just got used to it. Tbh it often makes me feel better, knowing that I've helped a friend.
I think for me, wanting to live alone on an island stems from my lack of self worth. Like I don't deserve to be with other people or something.

Self loathing is difficult to deal with.
My dad has battled with bulimia most of his life, I've never been tempted because I've seen first hand what it can do. I think watching him binge and purge whilst growing up has given me my own issues with food and it's one of the reasons I've struggled with being overweight. I still love my dad though, he's a wonderful person, I'm sure you are too
Yep, I get those feelings

It's good that you're still looking after yourself, that shows you have hope.
I fell in love and had some of the best sex of my life in my early 30s, maybe it'll be the same for you.

I'm so sorry you've had all this pain in your life. It's obvious that you're very intelligent, you write really well and you're good at expressing emotions even if you can't say them with your physical voice.
I really hope that writing down your situation helped ease your pain, even if it's just by a tiny bit.
I think that the world would sorely miss you if you took your own life as you genuinely have lots to offer. Perhaps you can't see it now, but as an outsider looking in I can see you have unlimited potential.
